test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about Mahatma Gandhi is INCORRECT?

options.text: Mahatma Gandhi was born in 1869 in Porbandar.
In 1942, he launched the Quit India Movement
He led the Champaran Satyagraha in 1910.
He led the Dandi Salt March in 1930.

solution:
The correct answer is __**He led the Champaran Satyagraha in 1910.**__
